meta.name: user-journey
meta.description: Build a persona-grounded user journey map for a product flow

copy.tagline: 绘制基于用户画像的产品流程体验地图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要梳理用户在产品中的完整行为路径和痛点。
copy.tagline_en: Map persona-based user journeys for your product flow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to map user behavior paths and pain points in your product.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步创建用户旅程地图：先确定用户角色，再定义任务起点和终点，然后绘制包含用户行为、想法、情绪和痛点的表格，最后总结关键时刻和改进机会。
howto.when: 当你描述一个具体的任务或流程（如“首次API集成”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我为“首次API集成”画一个用户旅程地图。
say.note: Claude 会先确认用户角色，然后逐步生成旅程地图。

say.text: 为“续订订阅”流程创建用户旅程。
say.note: Claude 会询问角色和边界条件，然后输出完整地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to create a user journey map step by step: pick a persona, define start and end states, map stages with actions, thoughts, emotions, and friction, then highlight moments of truth and opportunities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a specific task or flow (e.g., "first-time API integration").

say_en.text: Map a user journey for "first-time API integration".
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the persona and generate the journey map.

say_en.text: Create a user journey for "renewing a subscription".
say_en.note: Claude will ask about persona and boundaries, then output the full map.
